videos.video_subject: Yamal says Messi told him after the 2026 World Cup final to keep going his way and that the future belongs to their generation; words worth as much as his gold medal
videos.video_script: Yamal says Messi told him something after the World Cup final that he will never forget. Spain had just beaten Argentina, one-nil, after extra time. The two embraced on the pitch. Yamal says Messi told him to keep going his way, and that the future belongs to their generation. Yamal said those words mean as much to him as the gold medal around his neck. Was that the passing of the torch?
